slots_and_copies.name: global_config
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Absolute SRAM offset unresolved (_DAT_0800ba8c, fixed). Loaded once at cold boot by FUN_0800ba4c (called from FUN_080006d4) only if FUN_08000ff8(3) reports the config validity bit clear (present).

io_driver_functions.notes: Raw byte-copy primitive; sets an SRAM wait-control register bit pattern (|=3) before copying param_3 bytes one at a time. Confirms flat SRAM bus access (no Flash unlock sequence, no EEPROM DMA3 bitstream).

Low-level src,dst,size,retries transfer entry point used by every save read/write call site in this workspace. Body is an unresolved indirect jump-table trampoline in the decompilation; behavior inferred from all call sites (used for both SRAM->RAM and RAM->SRAM transfers depending on argument order).
Write-with-retry wrapper: calls FUN_080bcc58 then func_0x080bd178 up to 3 times, breaking on a zero (success) return.
Format/write function: bulk-copies a RAM buffer to SRAM 0x0E000000 in 0x1000-byte chunks, then writes the 15-byte magic to offset 0. Only called from the boot-time format-if-invalid path.
Magic/version verify function: reads 15 bytes from SRAM offset 0 and compares against a ROM literal; returns 1 on match, 0 otherwise. Gates every other save read in this workspace.
Reads a single flag byte from SRAM (offset unresolved, _DAT_08001024) and returns the complement of bit param_1 (1 = slot present, 0 = slot blank).

Per-file-slot loader: if magic valid and slot-flag set present, copies 20 bytes from SRAM (param_1*0x3F8 + base) into the RAM mirror (struct+param_2*0x14+0x20); otherwise zero-initializes the RAM record. No writer counterpart was found in this workspace.

Global-config loader: if magic valid and config-flag (bit 3) present, copies 76 bytes from a fixed SRAM offset into the RAM mirror (struct+0x35C). Called once at cold boot. No writer counterpart was found in this workspace.

open_questions: No checksum/CRC/integrity routine was found anywhere in the 177 decompiled functions. Confirm whether one of the un-decompiled callees (func_0x0801027c, func_0x080103ac, func_0x08010d44, func_0x080ba988) contains such a routine, or whether this title genuinely has none.

Absolute SRAM offsets for the three file-slot records, the global config block, and the 1-byte validity flag (_DAT_0800b9e0, _DAT_0800ba84, _DAT_0800ba88, _DAT_0800ba8c, _DAT_08001024, _DAT_08001020, _DAT_08000f20, etc.) are referenced only symbolically in this decompilation and were not resolvable to literal integers from the workspace text alone.

No writer function was found for the file-slot records or the global config block in this workspace -- only readers (FUN_0800b98c, FUN_0800ba4c) were traced. The actual in-game save-write path (presumably invoked from a save-menu/checkpoint trigger) is not covered by the 177 decompiled functions here.

Only one .sav sample (saves/cap-00-future-0.sav) was physically present in this workspace despite packet metadata referencing total_sav_files=6, and it is a freshly-formatted, never-played save (magic only, all else zero). No states/*.ss paired save states were present in this checkpoint cohort, so none of the fuzzing_targets predictions above could be runtime-verified in this session.

FUN_080041ac's offset-0x2A field check (used to set the file-select presence bitmask) was observed to run unconditionally on the same struct across all three loop iterations in the decompiled C, which may be an artifact of decompiler register/variable aliasing rather than true program behavior; needs confirmation via a live trace.
